messages.author: a7b469c7fad33292
messages.subject: shiny-server
parts:
Hi there,

I am having trouble getting my shiny server up and running.

I am sshing into a CentOS server, onto which if I have copied my code.  If I open R and use runApp("/var/shiny-server/www/mrlu", 3838), I can access the app just fine over the web and it works at HOST:3838.

If I type "sudo shiny-server" and go to HOST:3838/mrlu, I get the following:

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory Calls: runApp -> setwd Execution halted


Any idea of what might be the problem?  The server is clearly running, it is just failing to actually use the app.  There are no calls to setwd in my own code, so it must be part of the app's initialization.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny-server
parts: Does the user "shiny" have r-x permissions on /var/shiny-server/www/mrlu? By default, the "shiny" user is who launches the R processes that host Shiny apps.
